notes:
v1.12.0 Release:
- Clone Voices: each character keeps one voice. Speakers are found with better voice prints, so far fewer lines go to the wrong actor
- A line's Male/Female comes from the actor's voice, and Clone Voices sets it to the speaker's gender
- After Match Subtitles to Video the speakers are found again from the matched times
- Lovers speak to each other the right way in translation: he says អូន, she says បង
- Voice clips and speaker search use the separated vocals when the video has them
- Much faster exports with burned-in subtitle blur (a 7-minute vertical part: about 2.4x faster, same picture)
- Removed: the editor's Image and Video overlay tools, chroma key, and Dub Whole Series overlays and ads. Plain joins, free text, subtitles and blur boxes work as before; old presets that hold overlays still open

Also new since v1.6.0:
- v1.11.0: VoxCPM2 lines said like the actor, 4x faster lines, better Khmer reading
- v1.10.0: the export matches the editor
- v1.9.0: emotions for imported SRTs and on the voice pill, VoxCPM2 Khmer voice, series export folder
- v1.8.0: VoxCPM2 voice capture and voice groups, Fix Rushed Lines, Khmer pronouns
- v1.7.0: Khmer interface, Join into one video, Gemini model changes
